subject.title: backup create stalls on large installations (4GB+ .openclaw dir)

question: What native backup scope should `openclaw backup create` support for large state directories before this issue can close?
rationale: The remaining fix likely adds public CLI flags/default exclusions and protected restore semantics, which affects backup completeness and sensitive-state handling beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Review native exclusions
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 or a replacement PR as the vehicle for restore-safe smart/custom exclusions plus live proof.

options.title: Narrow to failure handling
options.body: Keep full backup scope as-is and fix only clear error reporting, cleanup, and progress for large archives.

options.title: Defer native scope controls
options.body: Document external/ClawHub backup tooling as the workaround and leave the core backup CLI coarse until maintainers revisit backup policy.

recommendation.title: Review native exclusions
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 or a replacement PR as the vehicle for restore-safe smart/custom exclusions plus live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the native backup CLI behavior and are the strongest history-backed owner for command semantics.
